yt.title: Email makes your attachments {c_pct}% bigger #Shorts
yt.description:
Email attachments are encoded as Base64 text: every 3 bytes become 4 characters (+33%, a bit more with line breaks).
Narration is AI-generated.

scenes.narration: Email makes your attachments about thirty three percent bigger.

rows.t: Email was built for text only

scenes.narration: Email was built for text only. So files are turned into letters: every three bytes become four characters. That's a third bigger.

scenes.text: A 10 MB file sends as {c_10} MB
scenes.narration: So a ten megabyte file travels as thirteen point three.
That's why attachment limits hit earlier than you expect.
For big files, send a link instead.
